question: Can unknown-profile recorder RGB predict independently measured Velvia 100F spectra through the exact retained CB4 dye coordinates with bounded low-capacity source-only coefficients?

evaluation.folds: all 6 test_set x 5 slide_index joint leave-one-set-and-slide-out folds
evaluation.freshness: model-new but all rows were consumed by earlier AQ/P6/CB4 experiments; not a pristine confirmation

candidate.target_coordinates: per-row nonnegative CB4 [base,yellow,magenta,cyan] oracle coefficients fitted only to construct development targets
candidate.fit: four independent scipy.optimize.lsq_linear nonnegative affine coefficient regressions per fold
candidate.apply: source features times fitted coefficient matrix, then exact fixed dye basis

controls.wrong_stock_bases: unchanged source-only coefficient mapping fitted separately for exact Velvia 50 and Provia 100F bases
controls.direct_nonnegative_spectral: same four source features fitted independently to each of 29 target density samples
controls.target_oracle: CB4 per-row target-consuming coefficient fit, diagnostic ceiling only

stop_rules: Do not change features, basis, coefficient sign, folds, controls or gates after formal scoring.
Failure closes this exact low-capacity recorder-RGB-to-dye-coordinate forward family without quadratic capacity, clipping, source-profile assumptions, row rescue or threshold relaxation.
Pass remains a manufactured-target recorder-proxy result and cannot establish camera-to-film, independent-roll, photographic or product behaviour.
claim_ceiling: Internal unknown-recorder-RGB to measured Velvia 100F manufactured-target spectral proxy evidence; not camera RGB, scene exposure, independent film response, calibration, photographic appearance or product profile.
